import openpyxl

    'L3': '=K3+1',
    'N3': '=M3+1',
    'U3': '=T3+1',
    'W3': '=V3+1',
}

    old = ws[coord].value
    ws[coord] = formula
    print(coord, old, '->', ws[coord].value)

wb.save(path)
print('saved')
